title: What is a fraction?
explanation: A fraction shows part of a whole. The bottom number (denominator) is how many equal pieces. The top number (numerator) is how many pieces you have.

title: Same denominator rule
explanation: To add or subtract fractions, the denominators must be the same. Keep the denominator, and add or subtract only the numerators!

title: Multiply & Divide rule
explanation: To multiply fractions, multiply top × top and bottom × bottom. To divide, flip the second fraction and then multiply.

title: Adding and subtracting fractions
explanation: It is easy when they have the same denominator.

title: ➕ Example 1
explanation: 1/4 + 1/4 = 2/4 = 1/2 — same denominator, just add the tops.

title: ➕ Example 2
explanation: 2/6 + 1/6 = 3/6 = 1/2 — three sixths is the same as one half!

title: ➕ Example 3
explanation: 3/8 + 3/8 = 6/8 = 3/4 — always simplify by dividing by the common factor.

title: ➕ Example 4
explanation: 1/3 + 1/3 = 2/3 — two thirds of a whole.

title: ➕ Example 5
explanation: 4/10 + 3/10 = 7/10 — the denominator stays 10.

title: ➖ Example 6
explanation: 3/4 − 1/4 = 2/4 = 1/2 — subtract the tops, keep the bottom.

title: ➖ Example 7
explanation: 5/6 − 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2 — three sixths simplifies to one half.

title: ➖ Example 8
explanation: 7/8 − 3/8 = 4/8 = 1/2 — divide both by 4 to simplify.

title: ➖ Example 9
explanation: 4/5 − 1/5 = 3/5 — three fifths remaining.

title: ➖ Example 10
explanation: 9/10 − 4/10 = 5/10 = 1/2 — five tenths is the same as one half.

title: ✖️ Multiplying fractions
explanation: Find a fraction of a fraction: multiply top × top and bottom × bottom.

title: ✖️ Example 1
explanation: 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4 — multiply tops: 1×1=1; bottoms: 2×2=4.

title: ✖️ Example 2
explanation: 2/3 × 3/4 = 6/12 = 1/2 — simplify by dividing top and bottom by 6.

title: ✖️ Example 3
explanation: 3/4 × 2/3 = 6/12 = 1/2 — same as above, order does not matter!

title: ✖️ Example 4
explanation: 1/3 × 1/3 = 1/9 — a third of a third is a ninth.

title: ✖️ Example 5
explanation: 2/5 × 5/6 = 10/30 = 1/3 — simplify 10 and 30 by dividing by 10.

title: ➗ Dividing fractions
explanation: Ask how many of the second fraction fit into the first one, then flip and multiply.

title: ➗ Example 6
explanation: 1/2 ÷ 1/4 = 1/2 × 4/1 = 4/2 = 2 — flip the second fraction then multiply.

title: ➗ Example 7
explanation: 3/4 ÷ 3/8 = 3/4 × 8/3 = 24/12 = 2 — the answer is 2 whole circles!

title: ➗ Example 8
explanation: 2/3 ÷ 1/3 = 2/3 × 3/1 = 6/3 = 2 — how many thirds fit in two thirds? Two!

title: ➗ Example 10
explanation: 1/4 ÷ 1/8 = 1/4 × 8/1 = 8/4 = 2 — two eighths fit in every quarter.
